$comment: Both URL and token are read from environment. NEVER inline a literal token here — the pre-deploy-check.sh refuses commits that contain eyJ-prefixed JWTs in this file. Set N8N_MCP_URL and N8N_MCP_TOKEN in your shell (or in ~/.zshenv / ~/.bashrc); pass --stdin to `claude mcp add-json` when installing interactively so the token never hits argv or shell history.
